answer: Require each agent to lock a scarce, nontransferable stake, released only after consistent behavior across independent counterparties. An attacker can still create many identities, but must fund each one and wait through a reputation-building period before gaining influence. A gale of fake profiles cannot share one account’s history; a sonnet of coordinated praise earns no shortcut. The cost is capital tied up and time spent while each identity climbs from its nadir of trust.
